experiment: STARTS S1ALT: block-alternating vs joint IID SPSA under frozen S1 at N15 L=2 Q=2048

hypothesis.one_sentence: At N15 L=2 under frozen S1, 50/50 block-alternating SPSA (shared Uc vs SNAP shells; QAOA gamma vs beta) beats joint IID SPSA on Nov3 energy at the same inclusive Q=2048.
hypothesis.not: No S1 start/gain retune. No extra Q. No S4/S8. No continuation. Not a GR patch.

frozen_from_PR83_87.JOINT: exact S1 joint IID C0 as PR87 L=2: nstarts=1 TQA, split_cap(2048,1) K=1019, ncal=4, A=25, live gain, last+Polyak, energy min, engine m2
frozen_from_PR83_87.ALT: same TQA start, same C0 4 full-vector calibration probes (charged), same live gain formula, same last+Polyak readout. K-loop De is full Rademacher then masked: odd k (k%2==0) block A only; even k block B only. joint_prefix_K=0.

blocks.Nov3: A = shared Uc [gamma, theta_K, theta_M] indices 0,1,2; B = all SNAP shells (s1,s2,s3)_l indices 3..8
blocks.QAOA: A = all gamma_l indices 0..L-1; B = all beta_l indices L..2L-1

allocation.S1: One TQA start. Full Q=2048 per arm. K=1019.
allocation.inclusive: All init, calibration, perturbations, candidates, failures inside Q. No free JOINT prefix.

selection: Lowest counted candidate energy. F post hoc, never selects.

gate.cell: N15 L2 Nov3, n=accepted seeds, energy E_ALT - E_JOINT
gate.pass: bootstrap 95% CI of the mean ΔE lies entirely below 0
gate.otherwise: reject ALT at L=2. Do not retune.
gate.nov3_vs_qaoa_alt: Reported separately. Mark ALT as a development energy-win candidate only if Nov3−QAOA mean Δ(E-E0)/N CI lies entirely below 0.
gate.gr: Do not patch GR even if the gate passes.
